periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled downward toward the muzzle at approximately 50 degrees from the horizontal.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical-ovoid morphology with height significantly exceeding width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward teardrop tapering with the majority of the pigment mass situated below the eye level.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior curve across the shoulders.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying roughly 40% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded with slight fur-texture irregularity on the upper boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct cream/yellowish hue present on the dorsal and cranial fur contrasting with the white facial fur.
